name: landing
title: Landing sections: hero, features, FAQ, call to action
description: Replaces views/home.brain with a landing page built from four sections: ui/hero (headline, lead, primary and secondary links), ui/feature-grid (cards from a list), comp/faq (accordion: one button per question with aria-expanded/aria-controls, several open at once) and ui/cta-band. The page carries enough text and internal links for the SEO audit.
notes: Section headings are h2 (the hero holds the page's only h1). Keep internal links in the copy (B1812).
